title: Ending a Queensland tenancy
description: Closing out a general tenancy in Queensland: the exit condition report and the bond refund. Summarised from RTA pages.

items.title: Have the tenant complete the Exit condition report (Form 14a), ideally together
Compare it with the entry condition report, allowing for fair wear and tear
Add your comments, sign and send the tenant a copy within three business days
Keep the entry and exit reports for at least a year after the tenancy ends
Apply for the bond refund through the RTA (Form 4)
If you claim against the bond, give the tenant your evidence within 14 days
If the claim is disputed, respond through the RTA's dispute resolution process
